# Desktop UI Guide

DesktopAppShell preserves context and keyboard efficiency for repeated, high-frequency IM work.

## Layout

AppLayout and Adaptive Layout use stable pane dimensions and explicit collapse rules.

## Input

Cover keyboard, shortcuts, focus, context menus, hover, drag and drop, and window resize. Shortcuts belong to the host; components emit command intent.

## Platforms

Vue PC is the behavioral reference. Flutter Desktop uses the same workspace contract and scenarios without copying business logic.
